knowledge_point.title: Determining an Intercept of a Tangent or Normal Line to a Curve Given in Implicit Form

question.:question/problem:
The curve has equation $x^{2} + 2 y^{2}=17$. The **tangent** line at $\left(3,2\right)$ meets the $x$-axis at $P$. Find the coordinates of $P$.

Give exact values.

$P=(${{field-1}}$,$ {{field-2}}$)$.
